                                    <u><a href="https://www.invisiblesociety.org" data-attached-link="{&quot;type&quot;:&quot;Web&quot;,&quot;url&quot;:&quot;https://www.invisiblesociety.org&quot;,&quot;title&quot;:&quot;https://www.invisiblesociety.org&quot;}" class="wz-link">https://www.invisiblesociety.org</a></u>

                <div style="text-align: center;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span></span><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span></span><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span></span><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span></span><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><span style="font-size:12px;"></span></span><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span></span><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><strong>&#8203;Qabbalah.Institute</strong></span></span></span><br></div>

    <section class="site-element" element-id="masterPageContentSectionId" element-type="SectionElement"></section>
    <div class="site-element" element-id="1402310978797" element-type="PageContentElement"></div>
    <section class="site-element" element-id="id1581627541146" element-type="SectionElement">
        <div class="element-children-container">
            <div class="site-element" element-id="id1581627740107" element-type="freeText">
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:20px;">The Orders</span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;">&#8203;</span></span><span style="font-size:12px;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><strong><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;">&#988;&#984;&#993;</span></span></strong><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;">©</span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong>&#988;&#984;&#993;</strong>©, <strong>V</strong>au <strong>Q</strong>oppa <strong>S</strong>ampi, is a secret Greek-letter fraternity. It is known as the Lost-Letters Fraternity because the letters vau, qoppa, and sampi are "lost" to the modern Greek alphabet. The secret Teachings of the Order are revealed in the 360 Degrees of the fraternity, but as a preliminary degree, an introduction to the fraternity is called</span></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong></strong></span><br><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong>0º</strong></span><br></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong><br>∴The Naught Degree∴<br><br>∴The Naught Degree = 0º = The Zero Degree∴</strong></span><br><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong></strong></span><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><br></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong>&#988;&#984;&#993;</strong>©, <strong>V</strong>au <strong>Q</strong>oppa <strong>S</strong>ampi, was our first Order, originally established as a fraternity for college and beyond.<br></span></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong>VQS</strong>©, <strong>V</strong>au <strong>Q</strong>oppa <strong>S</strong>ampi, was originally established as a club for high school and beyond.<br></span></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><br></span></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"><strong>&#988;&#984;&#993;</strong>©, <strong>V</strong>au <strong>Q</strong>oppa <strong>S</strong>ampi, is also known as</span><br></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><strong><span style="font-family:pt serif;">The Catch-On Game©</span></strong><br></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span><span style="font-family:pt serif;">The method of teaching used by the Orders of the Invisible Society© is called the heuristic method, that is,</span><br></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: center;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><strong><span style="font-family:pt serif;">The "Catch-On" Method</span></strong><br></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span class="theme-text-color-0-4"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;">Although much information is available to the general public and membership is open to all, the secrets of the Orders are "lost" to those who do not catch on.</span></span></span></div>
                <div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-family:pt serif;"></span></span><br></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
